items.q: What is AI by Hand trying to restore?
items.a: **Learning by hand at human pace** — write/draw every step of transformer math until the black box clicks. Struggle made visible is the point of the global initiative.

items.q: What happened when Yeh taught intro C++ on a blackboard?
items.a: Three effects: he could only write at **human speed**, students could only follow at human speed, and **hand-copied notes** kept phones off Instagram — focus improved.

items.q: Why doesn't having an answer mean you know it?
items.a: Degrees, certificates, and AI outputs are **proof artifacts**. Ownership — and how much you value knowledge — is **proportional to time spent acquiring it**.

items.q: What does the Gyeongbokgung palace metaphor teach?
items.a: Burned in the **1500s** except the rock foundation; rebuilt in the **1800s** on the same base. **Foundations survive** while surface tools burn away.

items.q: Which skills stay evergreen across AI hype cycles?
items.a: **Matrix multiplication** recurs from Jurassic Park CGI through big data, ML, AI, and likely quantum. Transformers will still matter when today's hot model (DeepSeek hype, etc.) is forgotten.

items.q: Is skipping piano practice worse than skipping one AI tool?
items.a: Yes — skip one AI product, fine; skip piano/soccer practice and you erode **who you are**. The **process** of acquiring hard skills becomes identity and transfers (Yeh caught up on deep learning using breakdown-by-hand).

items.q: What actually differentiates learners in the AI era?
items.a: Not memorizing transformer equations forever — proving **willingness** to take on hard learning challenges.

items.q: Why didn't ChatGPT killing Chegg fix academic cheating?
items.a: Chegg/AI are **symptoms**. The root is an **incentive system** that doesn't reward real learning investment.

items.q: Who should you hire if tools keep changing?
items.a: Hire for **work ethic, problem-solving, and teamwork** — those people adopt AI automatically. **"AI cannot change people — only you can change AI."
